# B2 Autos Recycling

> Licensed auto recycler and cash-for-cars buyer based at 340 Chemin Pincourt,
> Mascouche, Quebec. We buy scrap, damaged, non-running and end-of-life vehicles
> in any condition, tow them away free of charge, and pay cash on the spot.

## What we do

- Buy cars, trucks, vans and SUVs for cash regardless of condition — running or
  not, accident damaged, declared a total loss, missing an engine or wheels,
  failed inspection, or simply too old to repair.
- Free towing and pickup, often same-day or next-day.
- Handle the Quebec SAAQ ownership transfer and all paperwork on site at no cost.
- Environmentally responsible dismantling, fluid recovery and metal recycling.
- Pay cash on the spot at pickup. No towing fees, no admin fees, nothing deducted
  from the quoted amount.

## Service area

Mascouche, Terrebonne, Laval, Repentigny, Blainville, Bois-des-Filion, Lachenaie,
Saint-Eustache, Rosemère and Greater Montreal — the Montreal North Shore
(Rive-Nord) region of Quebec, Canada.

## Common questions

**How much is my car worth?**
It depends on the make, model, year and condition. Most scrap and end-of-life
vehicles in the Mascouche area fetch between $300 and $3,000 CAD. Call
+1 (514) 623-2787 or use the quote form at https://b2autos.com/#quote for a free,
no-obligation offer.

**Do you pick the car up?**
Yes. Towing is free for every vehicle we purchase, anywhere in our service area,
including evenings and weekends.

**What documents are required to sell a car in Quebec?**
The vehicle registration (certificat d'immatriculation) and valid photo ID. B2
Autos handles the SAAQ transfer and remaining paperwork on site.

**Do you buy cars that don't run?**
Yes — non-running, accident damaged, total loss, missing parts, or failed
inspection vehicles are all purchased.

**How fast is pickup?**
Often same-day or next-day, depending on location and schedule.

**How is payment made?**
Cash, on the spot, at the moment of pickup.

## How to contact

The fastest route is a phone call to +1 (514) 623-2787 — the line is answered
seven days a week. WhatsApp (https://wa.me/15146232787) is available for sending
photos of a vehicle. Written quote requests go through the form at
https://b2autos.com/#quote and receive an emailed cash offer.
